```{r, process for analysis}

library(data.table)

data <- fread("~/alphamissense_analysis/pfam&membrane_mapped_to_clinvar.txt")

data$database <- rep("ClinVar", nrow(data))

data <- subset(data, data$ReviewStatus == "criteria provided, single submitter" | data$ReviewStatus == "criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts" | data$ReviewStatus == "reviewed by expert panel" | data$ReviewStatus == "practice guideline")
data <- data[!data$alt == "-"]
data <- unique(data)


## Label ESM scores for each variant as pathogenic or benign

data <- rbind(esm1b_benign, esm1b_path, esm1b_ambiguous)
data <- rbind(data, esm1b_na)

esm1b_benign <- subset(data, data$esm1b_score >= (-7.5))

esm1b_path <- subset(data, data$esm1b_score < (-7.5))

esm1b_ambiguous <- subset(data, data$esm1b_score == (-7.5))

esm1b_na <- subset(data, is.na(data$esm1b_score))

sanity_che <- sum(nrow(esm1b_path), nrow(esm1b_benign), nrow(esm1b_ambiguous),nrow(esm1b_na))

esm1b_prediction <- rep("pathogenic", nrow(esm1b_path))
esm1b_path$esm1b_prediction <- esm1b_prediction

esm1b_prediction <- rep("benign", nrow(esm1b_benign))
esm1b_benign$esm1b_prediction <- esm1b_prediction

esm1b_prediction <- rep("", nrow(esm1b_na))
esm1b_na$esm1b_prediction <- esm1b_prediction

data <- rbind(esm1b_benign, esm1b_path)
data <- rbind(data, esm1b_na)


## Build am classification

am_benign <- subset(data, data$am_score <= 0.34)

am_path <- subset(data, data$am_score >= 0.564)

am_ambiguous <- subset(data, data$am_score > 0.34 & data$am_score < 0.564)

am_na <- subset(data, is.na(data$am_score))

sanity_che <- sum(nrow(am_path), nrow(am_benign),nrow(am_na))

am_prediction <- rep("pathogenic", nrow(am_path))
am_path$am_prediction <- am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("benign", nrow(am_benign))
am_benign$am_prediction <- am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("ambiguous", nrow(am_ambiguous))
am_ambiguous$am_prediction <- am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("", nrow(am_na))
am_na$am_prediction <- am_prediction

data <- rbind(am_benign, am_path, am_ambiguous)
data <- rbind(data, am_na)

am_benign <- subset(data, data$am_score <= 0.34)

am_path <- subset(data, data$am_score >= 0.564)

am_ambiguous <- subset(data, data$am_score > 0.34 & data$am_score < 0.564)

am_na <- subset(data, is.na(data$am_score))

sanity_che <- sum(nrow(am_path), nrow(am_benign), nrow(am_ambiguous),nrow(am_na))

am_prediction <- rep("pathogenic", nrow(am_path))
am_path$am_prediction <-am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("benign", nrow(am_benign))
am_benign$am_prediction <- am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("ambiguous", nrow(am_ambiguous))
am_ambiguous$am_prediction <- am_prediction

am_prediction <- rep("", nrow(am_na))
am_na$esm1b_prediction <- am_prediction

data <- rbind(am_benign, am_path, am_ambiguous)
data <- rbind(data, am_na)

## Simplify clinical outcome column to either benign or pathogenic (rather than likely pathogenic etc.)

clinical_pathogenic <- data[data$ClinicalSignificance == "Pathogenic" | data$ClinicalSignificance == "Likely pathogenic" | data$ClinicalSignificance == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"]
clinical_prediction <- rep("pathogenic", nrow(clinical_pathogenic))
clinical_pathogenic$clinical_prediction <- clinical_prediction

clinical_benign <- data[data$ClinicalSignificance == "Benign" | data$ClinicalSignificance == "Likely benign" | data$ClinicalSignificance == "Benign/Likely benign"]
clinical_prediction <- rep("benign", nrow(clinical_benign))
clinical_benign$clinical_prediction <- clinical_prediction

sanity_che2 <- sum(nrow(clinical_pathogenic), nrow(clinical_benign))

data <- rbind(clinical_benign, clinical_pathogenic)

data <- unique(data)

## put back diseases and somatic/germline

clinvar <- fread("~/alphamissense_analysis/clinvar_mapped_to_uniprot.csv")
clinvar <- subset(clinvar, clinvar$Type == "single nucleotide variant")
clinvar <- subset(clinvar, clinvar$Assembly == "GRCh38")
clinvar <- subset(clinvar, clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Pathogenic" | clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Likely pathogenic" | clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic" | clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Benign" | clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Likely benign" | clinvar$ClinicalSignificance == "Benign/Likely benign")
clinvar <- clinvar[!grep(pattern = "=", clinvar$Name, fixed = TRUE),]
clinvar <- clinvar[grep(pattern = "(p.", clinvar$Name, fixed = TRUE),]
clinvar <- clinvar[!grep(pattern = "Ter", clinvar$Name, fixed = TRUE),]

mapping <- clinvar[,c(2,7:9,23:24)]
disease_set <- merge(data, mapping, by = c("uniprot", "res_pos", "ref", "alt"))
disease_set <- unique(disease_set)

dup_rows <- duplicated(disease_set[, c("uniprot", "res_pos", "ref", "alt")], fromLast = TRUE)
disease_set <- disease_set[!dup_rows, ]

## add normalised esm1b scores

disease_set$esm1b_normalized <- (disease_set$esm1b_score - min(disease_set$esm1b_score)) / (max(disease_set$esm1b_score) - min(disease_set$esm1b_score))
disease_set$esm1b_normalized <- 1 - disease_set$esm1b_normalized

```

```{r, normalise esm1b scores for statistical test}

## normalise data and invert esm1b
data$esm1b_normalized <- (data$esm1b_score - min(data$esm1b_score)) / (max(data$esm1b_score) - min(data$esm1b_score))
data$esm1b_normalized <- 1 - data$esm1b_normalized

## perform statstical test on all data
wilcox.test(data$am_score, data$esm1b_normalized, paired = TRUE)$p.value

```

```{r, overall mcc and setup mcc analysis further}
data$clinical_prediction <- as.numeric(data$clinical_prediction)
data$am_prediction <- gsub("benign", x = data$am_prediction, replacement = "0")
data$am_prediction <- gsub("pathogenic", x = data$am_prediction, replacement = "1")

data$esm1b_prediction <- gsub("benign", x = data$esm1b_prediction, replacement = 0)
data$esm1b_prediction <- gsub("pathogenic", x = data$esm1b_prediction, replacement = 1)
data$esm1b_prediction <- as.numeric(data$esm1b_prediction)

data <- na.omit(data)

## calculate overall accuracy

esm_correct_counts <- nrow(data[data$esm1b_prediction == data$clinical_prediction,])
esm_total_counts <- nrow(data)
overall_esm_accuracy <- esm_correct_counts/esm_total_counts*100
```

```{r, build test function}

analyse_protein_group <- function(group_data, group_name, B = 5000) {

  ## Counts before filtering

  total_counts <- nrow(group_data)

  path_counts <- sum(
    group_data$clinical_prediction == 1,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  benign_counts <- sum(
    group_data$clinical_prediction == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  protein_count <- uniqueN(group_data$uniprot, na.rm = TRUE)

  ## Complete cases for paired model comparisons

  required_cols <- c(
    "clinical_prediction",
    "am_score",
    "esm1b_score",
    "am_prediction",
    "esm1b_prediction"
  )

  analysed <- group_data[
    complete.cases(group_data[, ..required_cols])
  ]

  analysed_counts <- nrow(analysed)

  analysed_path_counts <- sum(
    analysed$clinical_prediction == 1
  )

  analysed_benign_counts <- sum(
    analysed$clinical_prediction == 0
  )

  analysed_protein_count <- uniqueN(
    analysed$uniprot,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  ## Initialise results

  am_auc <- NA_real_
  esm_auc <- NA_real_
  auc_diff <- NA_real_
  auc_diff_ci_lower <- NA_real_
  auc_diff_ci_upper <- NA_real_
  auc_p <- NA_real_

  am_mcc <- NA_real_
  esm_mcc <- NA_real_
  mcc_diff <- NA_real_
  mcc_diff_ci_lower <- NA_real_
  mcc_diff_ci_upper <- NA_real_

  wilcox_p <- NA_real_

  ## MCC comparison

  if (analysed_counts > 0) {

    am_mcc <- mcc(
      analysed$clinical_prediction,
      analysed$am_prediction
    )

    esm_mcc <- mcc(
      analysed$clinical_prediction,
      analysed$esm1b_prediction
    )

    mcc_diff <- am_mcc - esm_mcc
  }

  ## Reverse ESM1b score for AUC calculation

  analysed[, esm1b_score_reversed := -esm1b_score]

  ## AUC and bootstrap require both clinical classes

  if (
    analysed_path_counts > 0 &
    analysed_benign_counts > 0
  ) {

    y <- analysed$clinical_prediction

    idx_0 <- which(y == 0)
    idx_1 <- which(y == 1)

    ## Original ROC curves

    roc_am <- roc(
      y,
      analysed$am_score,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    roc_esm <- roc(
      y,
      analysed$esm1b_score_reversed,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    am_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_am))
    esm_auc <- as.numeric(auc(roc_esm))

    auc_diff <- am_auc - esm_auc

    ## Paired DeLong test

    auc_p <- tryCatch(
      roc.test(
        roc_am,
        roc_esm,
        paired = TRUE,
        method = "delong"
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )

    ## Initialise bootstrap differences

    boot_auc_diff <- rep(NA_real_, B)
    boot_mcc_diff <- rep(NA_real_, B)

    ## Stratified paired variant-level bootstrap

    for (b in seq_len(B)) {

      sampled_idx <- c(
        sample(idx_0, length(idx_0), replace = TRUE),
        sample(idx_1, length(idx_1), replace = TRUE)
      )

      boot <- analysed[sampled_idx]
      yb <- boot$clinical_prediction

      ## AUC difference

      boot_auc_diff[b] <- tryCatch({

        auc_am_b <- as.numeric(auc(roc(
          yb,
          boot$am_score,
          levels = c(0, 1),
          direction = "<",
          quiet = TRUE
        )))

        auc_esm_b <- as.numeric(auc(roc(
          yb,
          boot$esm1b_score_reversed,
          levels = c(0, 1),
          direction = "<",
          quiet = TRUE
        )))

        auc_am_b - auc_esm_b

      }, error = function(e) NA_real_)

      ## MCC difference using the same sampled variants

      boot_mcc_diff[b] <- tryCatch(
        mcc(yb, boot$am_prediction) -
          mcc(yb, boot$esm1b_prediction),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }

    ## 95% percentile bootstrap CIs

    auc_ci <- get_boot_ci(boot_auc_diff)

    auc_diff_ci_lower <- auc_ci[1]
    auc_diff_ci_upper <- auc_ci[2]

    mcc_ci <- get_boot_ci(boot_mcc_diff)

    mcc_diff_ci_lower <- mcc_ci[1]
    mcc_diff_ci_upper <- mcc_ci[2]
  }

  ## Paired Wilcoxon test on normalised scores

  wilcox_cols <- c("am_score", "esm1b_normalized")

  if (all(wilcox_cols %in% names(group_data))) {

    wilcox_data <- group_data[
      complete.cases(group_data[, ..wilcox_cols])
    ]

    if (nrow(wilcox_data) > 0) {

      wilcox_p <- tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(
          wilcox_data$am_score,
          wilcox_data$esm1b_normalized,
          paired = TRUE
        )$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    }
  }

  ## Return one result row

  data.table(
    group = group_name,

    protein_count = protein_count,
    analysed_protein_count = analysed_protein_count,

    total_counts = total_counts,
    path_counts = path_counts,
    benign_counts = benign_counts,

    analysed_counts = analysed_counts,
    analysed_path_counts = analysed_path_counts,
    analysed_benign_counts = analysed_benign_counts,

    am_auc = am_auc,
    esm_auc = esm_auc,
    auc_diff = auc_diff,
    auc_diff_ci_lower = auc_diff_ci_lower,
    auc_diff_ci_upper = auc_diff_ci_upper,
    auc_p = auc_p,

    am_mcc = am_mcc,
    esm_mcc = esm_mcc,
    mcc_diff = mcc_diff,
    mcc_diff_ci_lower = mcc_diff_ci_lower,
    mcc_diff_ci_upper = mcc_diff_ci_upper,

    wilcox_p = wilcox_p
  )
}

```

```{r, overall bootstrap results}

library(data.table)
library(cvAUC)
library(mltools)
library(pROC)

# Convert clinical labels and predictions to numeric values
convert_prediction <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  result <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  result[x %in% c("benign", "0")] <- 0
  result[x %in% c("pathogenic", "1")] <- 1
  result
}

data[, clinical_prediction :=
       convert_prediction(clinical_prediction)]

data[, am_prediction :=
       convert_prediction(am_prediction)]

data[, esm1b_prediction :=
       convert_prediction(esm1b_prediction)]

# Run the paired bootstrap analysis on the full dataset
overall_bootstrap <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = data2,
  group_name = "Overall",
  B = 5000
)

# Convert results to a one-row table
overall_results <- as.data.table(overall_bootstrap)

# Save results
output_dir <- "~/alphamissense_analysis/results"

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

fwrite(
  overall_results,
  file.path(output_dir, "overall_am_esm1b_bootstrap_results.csv")
)

print(overall_results)

```

```{r, pfam mcc analysis}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Run through each Pfam id and calculate AUC and MCC
pfam_mccs <- data.table()

pfam_ids <- unique(data$pfam_id)

for (i in pfam_ids){
  
  family <- data[data$pfam_id == i]
  total_counts <- nrow(family)
  am_mcc <- mcc(family$clinical_prediction, family$am_prediction)
  esm_mcc <- mcc(family$clinical_prediction, family$esm1b_prediction)
  
  top_row <- family[1,]
  pfam_name <- top_row$pfam_name
  pfam_id <- top_row$pfam_id
  family_name <- top_row$name

  path_counts <- nrow(family[family$clinical_prediction == 1])
  benign_counts <- nrow(family[family$clinical_prediction == 0])
  
  if (path_counts > 0 & benign_counts > 0) {
    
    roc_object <- roc(family$clinical_prediction, family$am_score)
    am_auc <- roc_object$auc
    am_auc <- as.numeric(paste(am_auc))

    roc_object <- roc(family$clinical_prediction, family$esm1b_score)
    esm_auc <- roc_object$auc
    esm_auc <- as.numeric(paste(esm_auc))
  
  } else{
   
    esm_auc <- NA
    am_auc <- NA
    
  }
  
  row <- data.table(family_name, pfam_id, pfam_name, am_auc, esm_auc, am_mcc, esm_mcc, total_counts, path_counts, benign_counts)

  pfam_mccs <- bind_rows(pfam_mccs, row)
  
}

# Subset to specific number of minimum variants for each Pfam

pfam_mccs2 <- pfam_mccs[pfam_mccs$total_counts >= 20]
pfam_mccs2 <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$path_counts >= 1]
pfam_mccs2 <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$benign_counts >= 1]
pfam_mccs2 <- pfam_mccs2[-2,]

# Remove duplicate pfams
duplicates <- pfam_mccs[duplicated(pfam_mccs$pfam_id) | duplicated(pfam_mccs$pfam_id, fromLast = TRUE), ]

pfam_name <- pfam_mccs2$pfam_name
pfam_mccs2 <- pfam_mccs2[,-2]
pfam_mccs2 <- unique(pfam_mccs2)

# AM poor performance
pfam_less_0.6 <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$am_mcc < 0.6]
pfam_more_0.6 <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$am_mcc >= 0.6]

pfam_less_0.6_perc <- nrow(pfam_less_0.6)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100
pfam_more_0.6_perc <- nrow(pfam_more_0.6)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100

pfam_less_0.6_mean_counts <- mean(pfam_less_0.6$total_counts)
pfam_more_0.6_mean_counts <- mean(pfam_more_0.6$total_counts)

## ESM-1b poor performance
pfam_less_0.6_esm <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc < 0.6]
pfam_more_0.6_esm <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc >= 0.6]

pfam_less_0.6_perc_esm <- nrow(pfam_less_0.6_esm)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100
pfam_more_0.6_perc_esm <- nrow(pfam_more_0.6_esm)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100

pfam_less_0.6_mean_counts_esm <- mean(pfam_less_0.6_esm$total_counts)
pfam_more_0.6_mean_counts_esm <- mean(pfam_more_0.6_esm$total_counts)

## AM good performance
pfam_more_0.9_am <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$am_mcc >= 0.9]

pfam_more_0.9_perc_am <- nrow(pfam_more_0.9_am)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100

pfam_more_0.9_mean_counts_am <- mean(pfam_more_0.9_am$total_counts)

## ESM good performance
pfam_more_0.9_esm <- pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc >= 0.9]

pfam_more_0.9_perc_esm <- nrow(pfam_more_0.9_esm)/nrow(pfam_mccs2)*100

pfam_more_0.9_mean_counts_esm <- mean(pfam_more_0.9_esm$total_counts)

## AM vs ESM
pfam_am_mcc_w <- nrow(pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$am_mcc > pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc])
pfam_esm_mcc_w <- nrow(pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc > pfam_mccs2$am_mcc])
pfam_mcc_draw <- nrow(pfam_mccs2[pfam_mccs2$esm_mcc == pfam_mccs2$am_mcc])

## Pie chart of above

pie_data <- data.frame(
  category = c("AM", "ESM-1b", "Even"),
  value = c(pfam_am_mcc_w, pfam_esm_mcc_w, pfam_mcc_draw)  # Replace with your actual numbers
)

total <- sum(pie_data$value)
label <- pie_data$value/total * 100
label <- round(label, 2)
label <- paste0(label, "%")

model_comp_plot <- ggplot(pie_data, aes(x = "", y = value, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(width = 1, stat = "identity") +
  coord_polar("y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("AM" = "#48b846", 
                                "ESM-1b" = "#4959d1", 
                                "Even" = "grey")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            color = "black") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
```

```{r, protein mcc analysis}

library(dplyr)

# Run through each protein and calculate AUC and MCC

protein_mccs <- data.table()

proteins <- unique(data$uniprot)

for (i in proteins){
  
  protein <- data[data$uniprot == i]
  total_counts <- nrow(protein)
  am_mcc <- mcc(protein$clinical_prediction, protein$am_prediction)
  esm_mcc <- mcc(protein$clinical_prediction, protein$esm1b_prediction)
  
  top_row <- protein[1,]
  uniprot <- top_row$uniprot

  path_counts <- nrow(protein[protein$clinical_prediction == 1])
  benign_counts <- nrow(protein[protein$clinical_prediction == 0])  

  if (path_counts > 0 & benign_counts > 0) {
    
    roc_object <- roc(protein$clinical_prediction, protein$am_score)
    am_auc <- roc_object$auc
    am_auc <- as.numeric(paste(am_auc))

    roc_object <- roc(protein$clinical_prediction, protein$esm1b_score)
    esm_auc <- roc_object$auc
    esm_auc <- as.numeric(paste(esm_auc))
  
  } else{
   
    esm_auc <- NA
    am_auc <- NA
    
  }
  row <- data.table(uniprot, am_auc, esm_auc, am_mcc, esm_mcc, total_counts, path_counts, benign_counts)

  protein_mccs <- bind_rows(protein_mccs, row)
  
}

# Filter proteins with specific number of variants
protein_mccs2 <- protein_mccs[protein_mccs$total_counts >= 5]
protein_mccs2 <- protein_mccs2[protein_mccs2$path_counts > 1]
protein_mccs2 <- protein_mccs2[protein_mccs2$benign_counts > 1]

# Calculate mean am_mcc mean
overall_am_mean_protein_mccs <- mean(protein_mccs2$am_mcc)

# Calculate counts of proteins with greater pathogenic or benign variant counts
protein_mccs_patho <- protein_mccs2[protein_mccs2$path_counts > protein_mccs2$benign_counts]
protein_mccs_benign <- protein_mccs2[protein_mccs2$benign_counts > protein_mccs2$path_counts]
protein_mccs_equal <- protein_mccs2[protein_mccs2$benign_counts == protein_mccs2$path_counts]

patho_proteins <- protein_mccs_patho$uniprot
benign_proteins <- protein_mccs_benign$uniprot

patho_protein_data <- data[data$uniprot %in% patho_proteins]
benign_protein_data <- data[data$uniprot %in% benign_proteins]

patho_protein_mcc <- mcc(patho_protein_data$clinical_prediction, patho_protein_data$am_prediction)
benign_protein_mcc <- mcc(benign_protein_data$clinical_prediction, benign_protein_data$am_prediction)

## protein sup table for paper

id_mapper <- fread("~/alphamissense_analysis/HUMAN_9606_idmapping_selected.tab")
id_mapper <- id_mapper[,1:2]
colnames(id_mapper) <- c("uniprot", "gene")

protein_mccs2_table <- merge(id_mapper, protein_mccs2, by = c("uniprot"))
protein_mccs2_table[, gene := sub("_HUMAN", "", gene)]


fwrite(protein_mccs2_table, "~/alphamissense_analysis/sup_data/protein_results.csv")
  
```

```{r, disease set analysis}

disease_set$clinical_prediction <- gsub("benign", x = disease_set$clinical_prediction, replacement = 0)
disease_set$clinical_prediction <- gsub("pathogenic", x = disease_set$clinical_prediction, replacement = 1)
disease_set$clinical_prediction <- as.numeric(disease_set$clinical_prediction)
disease_set$am_prediction <- gsub("benign", x = disease_set$am_prediction, replacement = "0")
disease_set$am_prediction <- gsub("pathogenic", x = disease_set$am_prediction, replacement = "1")
disease_set$am_prediction <- as.numeric(disease_set$am_prediction)
disease_set$esm1b_prediction <- gsub("benign", x = disease_set$esm1b_prediction, replacement = 0)
disease_set$esm1b_prediction <- gsub("pathogenic", x = disease_set$esm1b_prediction, replacement = 1)
disease_set$esm1b_prediction <- as.numeric(disease_set$esm1b_prediction)

# Run through each disease in ClinVar and calculate AUC and MCC for each

disease_mccs <- data.table()

diseases <- unique(disease_set$PhenotypeList)

for (i in diseases){
  
  disease <- disease_set[disease_set$PhenotypeList == i]
  total_counts <- nrow(disease)
  am_mcc <- mcc(disease$clinical_prediction, disease$am_prediction)
  esm_mcc <- mcc(disease$clinical_prediction, disease$esm1b_prediction)
  
  top_row <- disease[1,]
  disease_name <- top_row$PhenotypeList

  path_counts <- nrow(disease[disease$clinical_prediction == 1])
  benign_counts <- nrow(disease[disease$clinical_prediction == 0])  

  if (path_counts > 0 & benign_counts > 0) {
    
    roc_object <- roc(disease$clinical_prediction, disease$am_score)
    am_auc <- roc_object$auc
    am_auc <- as.numeric(paste(am_auc))

    roc_object <- roc(disease$clinical_prediction, disease$esm1b_score)
    esm_auc <- roc_object$auc
    esm_auc <- as.numeric(paste(esm_auc))
  
  } else{
   
    esm_auc <- NA
    am_auc <- NA
    
  }
  row <- data.table(disease_name, am_auc, esm_auc, am_mcc, esm_mcc, total_counts, path_counts, benign_counts)

  disease_mccs <- bind_rows(disease_mccs, row)
  
}

# Filter diseases for specific amount of variants

disease_mccs2 <- disease_mccs[disease_mccs$total_counts > 4]
disease_mccs2 <- disease_mccs2[disease_mccs2$path_counts > 1]
disease_mccs2 <- disease_mccs2[disease_mccs2$benign_counts > 1]

overall_am_mean_disease_mccs <- mean(disease_mccs2$am_mcc)

disease_mccs_patho <- disease_mccs2[disease_mccs2$path_counts > disease_mccs2$benign_counts]
disease_mccs_benign <- disease_mccs2[disease_mccs2$benign_counts > disease_mccs2$path_counts]
disease_mccs_equal <- disease_mccs2[disease_mccs2$benign_counts == disease_mccs2$path_counts]

patho_disease <- disease_mccs_patho$uniprot
benign_disease <- disease_mccs_benign$uniprot

patho_disease_data <- disease_set[disease_set$uniprot %in% patho_disease]
benign_disease_data <- disease_set[disease_set$uniprot %in% benign_disease]

patho_disease_mcc <- mcc(patho_disease_data$clinical_prediction, patho_disease_data$am_prediction)
benign_disease_mcc <- mcc(benign_disease_data$clinical_prediction, benign_disease_data$am_prediction)

## disease sup table for paper

disease_mccs2_table <- disease_mccs2[!grepl("\\|", as.character(disease_name))]
disease_mccs2_table <- disease_mccs2_table[
  !grepl("\\||not provided|not specified|see cases|inborn genetic diseases", tolower(as.character(disease_name)))
]

fwrite(disease_mccs2_table, "~/am_comparison_project/alphamissense_analysis/sup_data/disease_results.csv")

```

```{r, analyse by variant origin}

library(data.table)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)
B <- 5000

## Initialise results table

origin_mccs <- data.table()

## Get unique Origins

origins <- unique(disease_set$Origin)

## Analyse each Origin

for (i in origins) {

  ## Subset data for current Origin

  origin <- disease_set[Origin == i]

  ## Run analysis function

  origin_results <- analyse_protein_group(
    group_data = origin,
    group_name = i,
    B = B
  )

  ## Append results

  origin_mccs <- rbind(
    origin_mccs,
    origin_results,
    fill = TRUE
  )
}

## Save results

fwrite(
  origin_mccs,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/origin_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

## Print results

print(origin_mccs)

```

```{r, analyse by review status}

library(data.table)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)
B <- 5000

## Initialise results table

review_mccs <- data.table()

## Get unique ReviewStatus values, including NA

reviews <- unique(disease_set$ReviewStatus)

## Analyse each ReviewStatus group

for (i in reviews) {

  ## Extract review-status group, including NA

  if (is.na(i)) {

    review_all <- disease_set[is.na(ReviewStatus)]
    review_name <- "NA"

  } else {

    review_all <- disease_set[ReviewStatus == i]
    review_name <- as.character(i)
  }

  ## Run analysis function

  review_results <- analyse_protein_group(
    group_data = review_all,
    group_name = review_name,
    B = B
  )

  ## Append results

  review_mccs <- rbind(
    review_mccs,
    review_results,
    fill = TRUE
  )
}

## Save results

fwrite(
  review_mccs,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/review_status_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

## Print results

print(review_mccs)
```

```{r, cancer analysis}
cancer_analysis13 <- disease_set[grep("Tumor", disease_set$PhenotypeList, ignore.case = T)]

cancer_analysis <- unique(rbind(cancer_analysis, cancer_analysis4))
cancer_analysis <- unique(rbind(cancer_analysis, cancer_analysis5))
cancer_analysis <- unique(rbind(cancer_analysis, cancer_analysis6))
cancer_analysis <- unique(rbind(cancer_analysis, cancer_analysis7))

  group_data = cancer_analysis,
  group_name = "Cancer",
  B = 5000
)

  cancer_results,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/cancer_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

  cancer2_results,

wilcox.test(cancer3_analysis$am_score, cancer3_analysis$esm1b_normalized, paired = TRUE)
```

```{r, diabetes}

library(data.table)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Monogenic diabetes
# --------------------------------------------------

monodiabetes_analysis <- disease_set[
  grep("Monogenic diabetes", PhenotypeList)
]

# Proportion of variants associated with UniProt P35557
P35557_count <- nrow(
  monodiabetes_analysis[uniprot == "P35557"]
)

P35557_perc <- P35557_count / nrow(monodiabetes_analysis)

# Run analysis
monodiabetes_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = monodiabetes_analysis,
  group_name = "Monogenic diabetes",
  B = 5000
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Maturity-onset diabetes of the young
# --------------------------------------------------

onsetdiabetes_analysis <- disease_set[
  grep("Maturity onset diabetes mellitus in young", PhenotypeList)
]

# Exclude entries containing a pipe character
onsetdiabetes_analysis <- onsetdiabetes_analysis[
  !grepl("[|;]", PhenotypeList)
]

onsetdiabetes_protein_list <- unique(onsetdiabetes_analysis$uniprot)
onsetdiabetes_protein_count <- length(onsetdiabetes_protein_list)

# Run analysis
onsetdiabetes_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = onsetdiabetes_analysis,
  group_name = "Maturity-onset diabetes (general)",
  B = 5000
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 2
# --------------------------------------------------

onsetdiabetes2_analysis <- disease_set[
  grep("Maturity-onset diabetes of the young type 2", PhenotypeList)
]

onsetdiabetes2_protein_list <- unique(onsetdiabetes2_analysis$uniprot)
onsetdiabetes2_protein_count <- length(onsetdiabetes2_protein_list)

# Run analysis
onsetdiabetes2_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = onsetdiabetes2_analysis,
  group_name = "Maturity-onset diabetes type 2",
  B = 5000
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# Combine results
# --------------------------------------------------

diabetes_results <- rbindlist(
  list(
    monodiabetes_results,
    onsetdiabetes_results,
    onsetdiabetes2_results
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Display results
print(diabetes_results)

# Save results
fwrite(
  diabetes_results,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/diabetes_phenotype_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

## Percentage of variant from hexokinase 4

onsetdiabetes_hexo4_count <- nrow(onsetdiabetes_analysis[onsetdiabetes_analysis$uniprot == "P35557"])
onsetdiabetes_hexo4_perc <- onsetdiabetes_hexo4_count/nrow(onsetdiabetes_analysis)

library(data.table)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. Hexokinase 4: monogenic diabetes
# --------------------------------------------------

monodiabetes_hexo4 <- monodiabetes_analysis[
  monodiabetes_analysis$uniprot == "P35557"
]

monodiabetes_hexo4_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = monodiabetes_hexo4,
  group_name = "Hexokinase 4: monogenic diabetes",
  B = 5000
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Hexokinase 4: maturity-onset diabetes
# Combine type 1 and type 2 phenotype subsets
# --------------------------------------------------

onsetdiabetes_hexo4 <- onsetdiabetes_analysis[
  onsetdiabetes_analysis$uniprot == "P35557"
]

onsetdiabetes_hexo4_2 <- onsetdiabetes2_analysis[
  onsetdiabetes2_analysis$uniprot == "P35557"
]

onsetdiabetes_hexo4 <- rbindlist(
  list(onsetdiabetes_hexo4, onsetdiabetes_hexo4_2),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Remove duplicate rows
onsetdiabetes_hexo4 <- unique(onsetdiabetes_hexo4)

onsetdiabetes_hexo4_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = onsetdiabetes_hexo4,
  group_name = "Hexokinase 4: maturity-onset diabetes",
  B = 5000
)


# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine results
# --------------------------------------------------

hexo4_results <- rbindlist(
  list(
    monodiabetes_hexo4_results,
    onsetdiabetes_hexo4_results
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

# Display results
print(hexo4_results)

# Save results
fwrite(
  hexo4_results,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/hexokinase4_diabetes_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

## assess overlap between mody, mody2 and monodiabetes

mody_overlap <- merge(monodiabetes_analysis, onsetdiabetes2_analysis, by = colnames(onsetdiabetes_analysis)) 
# Assuming same column names 
overlap_count <- nrow(mody_overlap) 
# Calculate percentage 
total_rows <- nrow(monodiabetes_analysis) 
mody_mono_percentage_overlap <- (overlap_count / total_rows) * 100 
# Output the percentage 
mody_mono_percentage_overlap

mody_overlap <- merge(onsetdiabetes_analysis, onsetdiabetes2_analysis, by = colnames(onsetdiabetes_analysis)) 
# Assuming same column names 
overlap_count <- nrow(mody_overlap) 
# Calculate percentage 
total_rows <- nrow(monodiabetes_analysis) 
percentage_overlap <- (overlap_count / total_rows) * 100 
# Output the percentage 
percentage_overlap

## Neonatal diabetes mellitus

neonataldiabetes_analysis <- disease_set[grep(x = disease_set$PhenotypeList, pattern = "Neonatal diabetes mellitus")]
neonataldiabetes_benign_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis[neonataldiabetes_analysis$clinical_prediction == 0])
neonataldiabetes_patho_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis[neonataldiabetes_analysis$clinical_prediction == 1])

## calculate accuracy

am_correct_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis[neonataldiabetes_analysis$am_prediction == neonataldiabetes_analysis$clinical_prediction,])
am_total_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis)
neonatal_am_accuracy <- am_correct_counts/am_total_counts*100

esm_correct_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis[neonataldiabetes_analysis$esm1b_prediction == neonataldiabetes_analysis$clinical_prediction,])
esm_total_counts <- nrow(neonataldiabetes_analysis)
neonatal_esm_accuracy <- esm_correct_counts/esm_total_counts*100
```

```{r, analyse kinase subgroups}

library(data.table)

# Define kinase subgroups by Pfam annotation
tyrosine_serine_threonine <- data[
  data$pfam_name == "Protein tyrosine and serine/threonine kinase"
]
tyrosine_serine_threonine_proteins <- unique(tyrosine_serine_threonine$uniprot)

kinase_domain <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF00069"]
kinase_domain_proteins <- unique(kinase_domain$uniprot)

histidine_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF13589"]
histidine_kinase_proteins <- unique(histidine_kinase$uniprot)

deoxy_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF01712"]
deoxy_kinase_proteins <- unique(deoxy_kinase$uniprot)

phosphatid_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF00454"]
phosphatid_kinase_proteins <- unique(phosphatid_kinase$uniprot)

dap_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF08477"]
dap_kinase_proteins <- unique(dap_kinase$uniprot)

phosphoglycerate_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF00162"]
phosphoglycerate_kinase_proteins <- unique(phosphoglycerate_kinase$uniprot)

guanylate_kinase <- data[data$pfam_id == "PF00625"]
guanylate_kinase_proteins <- unique(guanylate_kinase$uniprot)


# Extract all variants for proteins in each subgroup
tyrosine_serine_threonine_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% tyrosine_serine_threonine_proteins]

kinase_domain_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% kinase_domain_proteins]

histidine_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% histidine_kinase_proteins]

deoxy_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% deoxy_kinase_proteins]

phosphatid_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% phosphatid_kinase_proteins]

dap_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% dap_kinase_proteins]

phosphoglycerate_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% phosphoglycerate_kinase_proteins]

guanylate_kinase_variants <-
  data[data$uniprot %in% guanylate_kinase_proteins]


# Analyse each subgroup
# Use B = 50 for a quick test, then B = 5000 for final results

tyrosine_serine_threonine_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = tyrosine_serine_threonine_variants,
  group_name = "Tyrosine and serine/threonine kinase",
  B = 5000
)

kinase_domain_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = kinase_domain_variants,
  group_name = "Kinase domain PF00069",
  B = 5000
)
```

```{r, broad transmembrane analysis}

library(kableExtra)
library(magrittr)
library(data.table)

# Define output directory
results_dir <- "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/"

# Get unique membrane categories
membrane_features <- unique(data$membrane_domain)

# Initialise combined result tables
membrane_bootstrap_results <- data.table()
membrane_bootstrap_excl_results <- data.table()

for (i in seq_along(membrane_features)) {

  feature <- membrane_features[i]

  # Create a filename-safe category name
  if (is.na(feature)) {
    feature_name <- "missing"
  } else {
    feature_name <- gsub(
      "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", trimws(as.character(feature))
    )
    feature_name <- gsub("^_|_$", "", feature_name)
  }

  # Subset data for this membrane category
  if (is.na(feature)) {
    membrane <- data[is.na(data$membrane_domain), ]
  } else {
    membrane <- data[data$membrane_domain == feature, ]
  }

  # Skip empty categories
  if (nrow(membrane) == 0) {
    next
  }

  # 1. Non-exclusive bootstrap analysis
  result <- analyse_protein_group(
    group_data = membrane,
    group_name = paste("Membrane", feature_name),
    B = 5000
  )

  # Convert returned result to a data.table
  result_dt <- as.data.table(result)

  # Add category identifier
  result_dt[, membrane_feature := feature_name]

  # Append to combined results
  membrane_bootstrap_results <- rbindlist(
    list(membrane_bootstrap_results, result_dt),
    fill = TRUE
  )

  # 2. Exclusive bootstrap analysis
  # Exclude rows with multiple phenotypes, indicated by "|"
  membrane_excl <- membrane[
    !grepl("|", membrane$PhenotypeList, fixed = TRUE),
  ]

  if (nrow(membrane_excl) > 0) {

    result_excl <- analyse_protein_group(
      group_data = membrane_excl,
      group_name = paste(
        "Membrane", feature_name,
        "(excluding multiple phenotypes)"
      ),
      B = 5000
    )

    # Convert returned result to a data.table
    result_excl_dt <- as.data.table(result_excl)

    # Add category identifier
    result_excl_dt[, membrane_feature := feature_name]

    # Append to combined exclusive results
    membrane_bootstrap_excl_results <- rbindlist(
      list(membrane_bootstrap_excl_results, result_excl_dt),
      fill = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# Save combined results
fwrite(
  membrane_bootstrap_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "membrane_bootstrap_results.csv")
)

fwrite(
  membrane_bootstrap_excl_results,
  file.path(results_dir, "membrane_bootstrap_excl_results.csv")
)

# Inspect results
print(membrane_bootstrap_results)
print(membrane_bootstrap_excl_results)


## Identify number of proteins associated with each category of interest

transmem <- data[data$membrane_domain == "Transmembrane"]
transmem_proteins <- length(unique(transmem$uniprot))
wilcox.test(transmem$am_score, transmem$esm1b_normalized, paired = TRUE)

intramem <- data[data$membrane_domain == "Intramembrane"]
intramem_proteins <- length(unique(intramem$uniprot))
wilcox.test(intramem$am_score, intramem$esm1b_normalized, paired = TRUE)

topo <- data[data$membrane_domain == "Topological domain"]
topo_proteins <- length(unique(topo$uniprot))
wilcox.test(topo$am_score, topo$esm1b_normalized, paired = TRUE)

## Create a table which I can present

data_presentable <- membrane_perf
colnames(data_presentable) <- c("Membrane Feature", "AM AUC", "ESM-1b AUC", "AM MCC", "ESM-1b MCC", "Total counts", "Pathogenic counts", "Benign counts")

data_presentable$`AM AUC` <- round(data_presentable$`AM AUC`, digits = 4)
data_presentable$`ESM-1b AUC` <- round(data_presentable$`ESM-1b AUC`, digits = 4)
data_presentable$`AM MCC` <- round(data_presentable$`AM MCC`, digits = 4)
data_presentable$`ESM-1b MCC` <- round(data_presentable$`ESM-1b MCC`, digits = 4)

data_presentable <- data_presentable[-1,]

membrane_table <- data_presentable %>%
  kbl(caption = "Membrane Results") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = F, html_font = "Cambria")

membrane_table
```

```{r, growth factors & cytokines}

library(data.table)
library(pROC)

set.seed(123)
B <- 5000

## Read protein lists

gf <- fread(
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/protein_groupings/growth_factors.csv",
  header = FALSE
)

cytokines <- fread(
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/protein_groupings/cytokines.csv",
  header = FALSE
)

## Select variants using the original protein lists

gf_variants <- data[
  uniprot %in% gf$V1
]

cytokine_variants <- data[
  uniprot %in% cytokines$V1
]

## Combined group: union of both original groups
## Remove duplicate rows from the combined group only

gf_cytokines_variants <- unique(
  rbindlist(
    list(
      gf_variants,
      cytokine_variants
    ),
    use.names = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  )
)

## Run growth factors analysis

gf_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = gf_variants,
  group_name = "Growth factors",
  B = B
)

## Run cytokines analysis

cytokine_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = cytokine_variants,
  group_name = "Cytokines",
  B = B
)

## Run combined growth factors and cytokines analysis

gf_cytokines_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = gf_cytokines_variants,
  group_name = "Growth factors and cytokines",
  B = B
)

## Combine results

gf_cytokine_results <- rbindlist(
  list(
    gf_results,
    cytokine_results,
    gf_cytokines_results
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = TRUE
)

## Print results

print(gf_cytokine_results)

## Save results

fwrite(
  gf_cytokine_results,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/growth_factors_cytokines_bootstrap_results.csv"
)
```

```{r, tubulin normal results}
]

# Inspect remaining Pfam IDs
unique(am_tubulin_analysis$pfam_id)

# Identify proteins
tubulin_protein_list <- unique(am_tubulin_analysis$uniprot)
tubulin_protein_count <- length(tubulin_protein_list)

# Include all variants from the identified proteins
am_tubulin_analysis <- data[
  data$uniprot %in% tubulin_protein_list
]

# Run the same analysis as the other protein groups
# Use B = 50 for a quick test, then B = 5000 for final results
tubulin_results <- analyse_protein_group(
  group_data = am_tubulin_analysis,
  group_name = "Tubulin",
  B = 5000
)

# Display results
print(tubulin_results)

# Save results
fwrite(
  tubulin_results,
  "~/alphamissense_analysis/results/tubulin_bootstrap_results.csv"
)

```
